title: Tuviah bar Yitzchak

paragraphs: In [Eruvin 28b](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.28b.21): Rabbah bar Tuviah bar Yitzchak. Hyman reports that in Dikdukei Soferim the words “bar Tuviah” are absent, leaving only Rabbah bar Yitzchak.[^1]

notes.text: The linked passage has Rabbah bar Tuviah bar Yitzchak speaking in Rav’s name. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3151&lang=en) records the same chain. Hyman attributes the shorter name to Dikdukei Soferim.
